question: What claim about success is at stake in making it conditional on knowing the eight-times-eight method?
premises: The eight-times-eight method must be known.
inference: Success is strictly conditional on knowing the eight-times-eight method and fails if known otherwise.
uncertainties: The content of the eight-times-eight method is not specified by this verse alone.
plain_english: Having known the eight-times-eight method, one succeeds; not otherwise.
